title: Captain Michalis
body:
Listening to Hadjidakis's album
"Captain Michalis"
inside the bus,
while, at the same time, outside my headphones
the voices of young Turkish fellow passengers
stand out, chatting and laughing.

Kazantzakis's reality wouldn't be much different.
Nor Captain Michalis's.

I smiled. The world is changing, Kemal.

y.f.
